errata.now: At her withdrawal of consent the plate is replaced on axnidentifiers.org by the display derivative of EA-ACT-ANALOG-01 (AXN:0706), and the stored original of Paper 198 is no longer served; its witness entry keeps the hash. This deposit is a dated snapshot of the site's source and keeps its bytes; the image path and the stored-original link it carries no longer resolve.
